flags.detail: The gate's ceiling counts substantial blind arcs, and writing THIS arc's own FINDINGS.md (a substantial instrument arc with no lexicon motif) immediately incremented the count from 8 to 9, breaking the ceiling the arc had just set -- the arc discloses this itself and the next arc (B823) redesigns the gate from a threshold to a triage registry specifically to fix this.

test_b731_revival_score_no_longer_contradicts_its_own_note and test_no_row_tops_the_revival_ranking_while_declaring_itself_retracted read revival_score/note fields directly from the arc's own kill_graph.json

All assertions read verdict/claim_one_line fields directly from the arcs' own arc_verdict.json / FINDINGS.md files; the docstring itself says 'The verdicts are read OFF the arcs, not invented' -- i.e. this test verifies self-consistency of authored text, not an independently recomputed fact

The arc itself names the pattern: the reframe's chirality=order-parameter identification is diagnosed as importing intuition from the Q case (where Gal(Q^ab/Q) does contain complex conjugation via the cyclotomic character) into the K=Q(sqrt-3) case where the analogous group (Gal(K^ab/K)) is strictly smaller -- a right-object-wrong-level error the arc catches rather than commits, which is a strength, but the underlying physical claim being tested (chirality as a Galois-label order parameter for a beta=1 SSB) is itself only ever supported by a group/type coincidence in the source arc B723, not by an independent physical measurement.

The core reduction (dense length spectrum => type III_1 von Neumann algebra) is explicitly and repeatedly flagged by the arc itself as a DECLARED CITATION not verified in this sandbox, with a named specific weak point (cusp excursions / infinite invariant measure breaking the compact-Anosov transfer theorem) -- the arc is careful about this, but the physics interpretation (an operator-algebra type standing in for whether an SSB clock is 'spontaneous') still rests on an unverified type-theoretic identification.

The arc explicitly diagnoses its own risk: the reframe's chirality-as-order-parameter idea may be imported intuition from the well-known Q-case (where Gal(Q^ab/Q) via the cyclotomic character DOES contain complex conjugation) into the K=Q(sqrt-3) case where the analogous but distinct group does not -- a same-shape-different-object confusion the arc names directly as the likely source of the original claim's error.
